notes: A227864_conj3 (A227864_mathlib.lean): if 2 | n or 3 | n, n not in {2,3}, b >= 2, gcd(b,n) = 1, then rev b n = ofDigits b (digits b n).reverse is not prime (b = +-1 mod q makes reversal = +- n mod q, and rev is an involution when b does not divide n). This is Conjecture 3 read as stated (restricted a(n) = 0 outside 2, 3, 6k+-1). A227864_conj2: every prime p >= 3 has prime reversal in base p - 1 (written 11), so Conjecture 2 holds. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Conjecture 1 (only 0, 1, 4 have no base) and the converse half of Conjecture 3 remain open; checked for n <= 10^6 by certificate/search.py. Outside Lean: the Conjecture 1 computation to 10^6 (Python); the two proved conjectures have no step outside Lean.
